T: Check in for supper. Check out early.
D: A thief on the run checks into a remote motel run by a troubled young man.
P: Serve the sandwiches when Norman brings Marion supper in the parlour.
S: Crustless ham and Swiss triangles on buttered white bread with Dijon
Leg ham and Swiss on buttered white bread with mustard, crusts off, cut into neat triangles, milk on the side.
Pickling onions in sweet malt vinegar with peppercorns
Small onions peeled, brined overnight, packed in hot spiced vinegar with sugar and peppercorns, pickled a week.
M: the lunch-hour hotel room in Phoenix, lunch left uneaten

Seared minute steak with caramelised onions, Swiss cheese and horseradish mayo on toasted rye, with a pile of shoestring fries and dill pickles. Cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter over low heat for 20 minutes until golden. Fry 600g frozen shoestring fries at 220C for 20 minutes. Season 4 minute steaks and sear in a smoking pan 1 minute a side. Lay a slice of Swiss cheese on each and cover for 30 seconds. Mix 80g mayonnaise with 1 tbsp horseradish. Toast 8 slices rye bread and build with mayo, steak and onions. Serve with fries and pickles.
Chicken, carrots and celery in a creamy broth with self-raising dumplings
Chicken simmered in a creamy broth with vegetables and fluffy herb dumplings. Simmer 1kg chicken thighs with carrots, celery, onion and 1.5L stock for 30 minutes, shred the meat and add 100ml cream.
W: Crisp white meringues piped in tall swirls
Swiss meringue piped into tall swirls, baked at 100C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven. Raspberry coulis drizzled over.
K: Brandy, cold milk and vanilla shaken with ice

Cold full cream milk shaken with brandy, vanilla and a little sugar syrup until frothy, served over ice with freshly grated nutmeg. For each drink, shake 120ml cold full cream milk, 45ml brandy, 15ml sugar syrup and a few drops of vanilla extract with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into 4 small glasses over a large ice cube and grate nutmeg over the top. Totals are 480ml milk, 180ml brandy and 60ml sugar syrup. Leave the brandy out for a plain vanilla milk.

s.note: Crustless ham and Swiss triangles on buttered white bread with Dijon
s.how: Butter 8 slices white bread and spread with Dijon. Fill with 200g sliced ham and 100g Swiss cheese. Cut off the crusts and cut into neat triangles. Serve on a plate with a glass of milk alongside.

s.note: Pickling onions in sweet malt vinegar with peppercorns
s.how: Peel 500g pickling onions and soak in salted water overnight. Rinse and pack into a jar. Boil 500ml malt vinegar with 100g sugar and 1 tsp peppercorns and pour over hot. Seal and leave a week before eating.

m.note: Chicken, carrots and celery in a creamy broth with self-raising dumplings
m.how: Simmer 1kg chicken thighs with carrots, celery, onion and 1.5L stock for 30 minutes, shred the meat and add 100ml cream. Mix 200g self-raising flour, 40g butter, parsley and 150ml milk, drop spoonfuls on top, cover and cook 15 minutes.

w.note: Crisp white meringues piped in tall swirls
w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites and 180g sugar over simmering water until hot, then beat to stiff peaks. Pipe tall swirls and bake at 100C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Blitz 200g raspberries with lemon juice and sugar and drizzle over.
